input.summary: Insert new Section 20 (Indemnification): Vendor defence/indemnity for IP, breach of law, data breach and gross negligence/wilful misconduct; narrow Customer indemnity; standard procedure; and Section 20.5 infringement remedies referenced by Section 9.3.
input.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement has no indemnification section at all — Section 20 is missing even though Section 9.3 relies on "the remedies required by Section 20.5" and Section 21.3 treats indemnification obligations as Excluded Claims. We have inserted our standard Vendor indemnity (third-party IP infringement, breach of Applicable Law, Vendor-caused compromise of Customer Data, and gross negligence or wilful misconduct), with a reciprocal but narrow Customer indemnity limited to Customer-provided content and Customer's breach of law, plus customary procedure, exclusions and infringement remedies.

ops.text: Vendor shall defend, indemnify and hold harmless Customer and its Affiliates from and against any third-party claim, and all resulting damages, liabilities, costs and expenses (including reasonable attorneys' fees) finally awarded or paid in settlement, to the extent arising out of (a) an allegation that the Services, Deliverables, or Vendor Technology infringe or misappropriate any intellectual property right; (b) Vendor's breach of Applicable Law; (c) any unauthorized access to, acquisition, or disclosure of Customer Data caused by Vendor or its personnel, Affiliates, or subcontractors; or (d) Vendor's gross negligence or wilful misconduct.

Customer shall defend, indemnify and hold harmless Vendor from and against any third-party claim, and all resulting damages, costs and expenses (including reasonable attorneys' fees) finally awarded or paid in settlement, to the extent arising out of (a) an allegation that content or materials furnished by Customer to Vendor for use in the Services infringe or misappropriate any intellectual property right; or (b) Customer's breach of Applicable Law. Customer has no other indemnification obligation under this Agreement.

The indemnified Party shall give the indemnifying Party prompt written notice of the claim, provided that delay relieves the indemnifying Party only to the extent it is materially prejudiced. The indemnifying Party controls the defence and settlement with counsel reasonably acceptable to the indemnified Party, and the indemnified Party shall provide reasonable cooperation at the indemnifying Party's expense and may participate with its own counsel at its own expense. The indemnifying Party shall not settle a claim in a way that imposes a non-monetary obligation, admission of liability, or unreimbursed payment on the indemnified Party without its prior written consent.

Vendor's obligation under Section 20.1(a) does not apply to the extent the claim arises from Customer's modification of the Services or a Deliverable other than as authorized by Vendor or the documentation, combination of the Services or a Deliverable with items not supplied or recommended by Vendor where the claim would have been avoided but for the combination, or Vendor's compliance with written specifications supplied by Customer that Vendor did not select or recommend.

If a claim under Section 20.1(a) is made or Vendor reasonably believes one is likely, Vendor shall, at its expense and at Customer's option, procure the right for Customer to continue using the affected item or modify or replace it with a functionally equivalent, non-infringing item that continues to satisfy this Agreement and the applicable Order Form. If Vendor cannot do so on commercially reasonable terms, Customer may terminate the affected Services, Deliverables, or Order Form and Vendor shall refund prepaid Fees for the terminated portion and, for a paid-up licence, the Fees paid for the affected item.
